messages:
maria: Quick accessibility weirdness noticed during the console pass: when you keyboard-tab through the model list in the Insights panel, VoiceOver jumps to the top of the window whenever the virtualized list re-renders. Repro steps: open Insights > focus list > repeatedly press Tab to move through action buttons.
alex: ugh that sounds like the list is re-mounting or focus is being moved programmatically. Is it only VoiceOver or NVDA too?
maría: only tested VoiceOver on mac so far. NVDA might behave differently but probably related.
sam: can you paste a small repro? maybe there's a focus() call in the virtualized row component.
maria: here's the minimal trace I found in the console when I tabbed: 
```
[virtual-list] rehydrate rows: startIndex=12 endIndex=20
focus: element not focusable -> fallback to body
```
I also saw a11y-bot warning: "ROVING_TABINDEX: element lost programmatic focus"
lisa: hmm — if rows are unmounted and a new row gets inserted at a different index the focus target might disappear. Suggest we add `data-focus-id` and preserve focus by mapping to the next visible node rather than calling focus on mount.
alex: +1. Another quick win: when a row unmounts, place a visually-hidden sentinel (role="status" aria-live="polite") that announces "moved to next row" so screen reader users don't lose context. Might be noisy though.
sam: that could help. Also confirm the tab order: are action buttons reachable in DOM order or via roving tabindex?
maria: currently roving tabindex on the row container controlling arrow navigation, and Tab goes into the row's first action. The container uses `tabindex="0"` and rows set tabindex dynamically.
a11y-bot: Automated check results: contrast-warnings=0; focus-visible-missing=2; aria-roles-mismatch=1; virtualized-focus-heuristic=FAIL
lisa: the missing focus-visible are the small icon buttons in compact mode. We should ensure :focus-visible shows 2px outline in both themes. I can add CSS patch.
alex: for the ARIA role mismatch: the row container claims role="listitem" but its child has role="button" and we nest more buttons inside; screen readers may flatten roles. Consider using role="row" / role="grid" pattern instead and ensure keyboard interactions line up.
maria: agree. Plan of action: (1) switch rows to role="row" inside a grid wrapper; (2) on unmount, compute next tabbable node and move focus there instead of fallback; (3) add hidden live region sentinel as a fallback for Safari/VoiceOver only; (4) bump focus-visible outline for compact icon buttons.
sam: timeline? I can take (2) and (3) — should be a small renderer patch.
lisa: I’ll do (4) and the CSS variables so dark/light both get good contrast.
alex: I’ll own (1) and audit any other lists that use roving tabindex.
maria: thanks team. tagging @frontend-ship so this doesn't get lost. Can we do a short QA script for engineering: 
- macOS + VoiceOver: open Insights, focus first row, repeatedly press Tab and ArrowDown, verify focus moves and screen reader doesn't jump to top
- Windows + NVDA: same flow
- Mobile: ensure virtual list reflow on orientation doesn't steal focus
Any volunteer to run Windows NVDA?
sam: I can run NVDA quick check tomorrow.
a11y-bot: Note added to backlog ticket RT-4123. Priority: medium.
maria: perfect. If we can get a small PR with tests + manual QA notes by EOD Wednesday that'd be great. I'll update the ticket with the repro and attach the VoiceOver recording. :thumbsup:
alex: sounds good — I'll spike the role/grid changes and file PR draft.
lisa: will add CSS and tests for focus-visible snapshot.
